root_cause.text: When ADD_OUT_STREAMS is denied, the SCTP stream cleanup only shrinks queued chunks and decrements outcnt without properly tearing down the scheduler state and stream ext metadata, leaving behind stale pointers that cause a null-pointer dereference in the scheduler get path upon a later re-add.
root_cause.evidence: The patch description notes: "That leaves removed stream metadata behind, so a later re-add can reuse a stale ext and hit a null-pointer dereference in the scheduler get path." The fix replaces the incomplete `sctp_stream_shrink_out` call with a full rollback that unschedules, migrates (via `sctp_stream_outq_migrate`), and reschedules the streams, matching the behavior of other stream resize operations.
